explain title:value=R8 title=R8
requirement R1 The page starts as the contract says: the form, an empty list, `0 left`, and the title `0 left`
requirement R2 Typing in the input stores the draft, and the input shows it as its value
requirement R3 Submitting a non-empty draft adds an item at the front of the list: the trimmed text, the next id counting from 1, a todo button, and the input is cleared
requirement R4 Submitting an empty draft adds nothing
requirement R5 The toggle button flips one item between todo and done, and puts the class done on its label while it is done
requirement R6 The remove button deletes one item, and an id is never used twice
requirement R7 The count paragraph reads `<n> left`, n being the number of items that are not done
requirement R8 document.title is `<n> left` after every step
requirement R9 Items are keyed by id: nodes of items that stay are kept (same nodes) when others are added, toggled or removed
requirement E2E Long sessions: scripted, and seeded random ones
